subject.title: [Feature]: Expose sessionKey/runId to outbound message hook for deterministic verification

question: What outbound plugin-hook evidence contract should OpenClaw support for deterministic pre-send verification?
rationale: The remaining work is a public Plugin SDK and privacy/security boundary decision: maintainers need to choose whether runId, recent transcript/tool calls, tool results, model/run metadata, and cancellation semantics belong on `message_sending`, `reply_payload_sending`, or a broader policy/trace API.

options.title: Design bounded hook evidence
options.body: Specify minimal redacted run/session/evidence fields for the supported pre-send hook before implementation.

options.title: Route to reply_payload_sending
options.body: Declare `reply_payload_sending` plus existing run context as the supported API and narrow this issue to missing docs or evidence gaps.

options.title: Fold into broader trace work
options.body: Make a broader trace/outbound policy issue canonical after preserving this issue's deterministic verification examples.

recommendation.title: Design bounded hook evidence
recommendation.body: Specify minimal redacted run/session/evidence fields for the supported pre-send hook before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the closest prior outbound and reply-payload hook changes and already reviewed this exact remaining contract gap.
